summary: From one frozen score-blind squad, score_xp minus expected points is -0.29 [-0.87, +0.31] on the decision week and covers zero. Over three weeks the same contrast is -1.69 [-2.92, -0.52] and stays below zero in every season. That is not a decision to replace score_xp. Against a within-week shuffle the one-week gap is +3.98 [+2.83, +5.13]. Legal-move concordance is +0.014 [+0.007, +0.019]. The 2022-23 squad gap of -14.45 is not the sum of that week's transfers (+1.24). No winner and no model change.
